# IR-EMPOWER 2024

**Workshop on Infrared Emissivity Measurements — first edition**

| | |
|---|---|
| **Dates** | 5–6 September 2024 |
| **Venue** | Bizkaia Aretoa, Bilbao, Spain |
| **Organized by** | Thermophysical Properties of Materials Research Group (Thermomat / HAIRL), UPV/EHU |
| **Participating institutions** | PTB · CAE · CEMHTI-CNRS · PROMES-CNRS · LTeN-CNRS · IMT Mines Albi · JRC Karlsruhe · INO-CNR · Vinča Institute · Czech Academy of Sciences (ISI Brno) · University of West Bohemia · Ruhr University Bochum · University of Wisconsin–Madison · University of Virginia · LASP Boulder · UPV/EHU |
| **Original website** | [dulcet-sundae-44ceba.netlify.app](https://dulcet-sundae-44ceba.netlify.app/) (frozen legacy copy) |

The first IR-EMPOWER brought together, over two days in Bilbao, the European
and American laboratories working on infrared emissivity measurement —
metrology institutes, high-temperature facilities, and university groups —
for twenty-one talks spanning techniques below and above 1000 K, cryogenic
and ultra-high-temperature measurement, instruments, and open data. The talk
*"Towards an Open Community of Radiative Properties"* (J. Gabirondo-López)
outlined what would become [EKHI](/data/ekhi.html) and this site.

Jochen Manara (CAE, Würzburg) · Christian Monte (PTB, Berlin) · Olivier
Rozenbaum (CEMHTI, Orléans) · Konstantinos Boboridis (JRC, Karlsruhe) ·
Audrey Soum-Glaude (PROMES, Odeillo)

## Program — Thursday 5 September 2024

| 09:00–09:15 | Opening remarks | |
| 09:15–10:15 | **Emissivity measurements below 1000 °C at PTB — an overview** *(plenary)* | Albert Adibekyan (PTB, Berlin) |
| 10:45–11:45 | **Applied metrological facilities for determining the emissivity in a wide temperature range** *(plenary)* | Jochen Manara (CAE, Würzburg) |
| 11:45–12:15 | Measuring the spectral emissivity above 1000 K | David Urban (PTB, Berlin) |
| 13:45–14:15 | Direct measurement of infrared emission using Fourier-transform spectroscopy | Hongyan Mei (University of Wisconsin–Madison) |
| 14:15–14:45 | High-temperature emissivity of cerium oxide ceramics | Léo Gaillard (LTeN-CNRS, Nantes) |
| 15:15–15:45 | Developing a modular and high-performance infrared emissometer | Mireia Sainz-Menchón (UPV/EHU, Leioa) |
| 15:45–16:15 | Towards an open community of radiative properties | Jon Gabirondo-López (UPV/EHU, Leioa) |
| 16:15–16:45 | Radiative heat transfer measurements in packed beds | Matthias Tyslik (Ruhr University, Bochum) |
| 16:45–17:15 | Time-resolved emissivity of biomass fuel particles | Lukas Pörtner (Ruhr University, Bochum) |
| 19:00–22:00 | Conference dinner | |
